messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites MS C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

<original_code>
#include<iostream>
#include<vector>
#include<string>
#include<cmath>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include<iomanip>
#include<algorithm>
#include<assert.h>
#include<deque>
#include<set>
#include<map>
#include<fstream>
#include<istream>
#include<ostream>
using namespace std;

#define ll				long long
#define MP				make_pair
#define ull				unsigned long long
#define vint			vector<int>
#define vid				vector<double>
#define vll				vector<ll>
#define pb				push_back
#define PI				3.1415926536
#define all(v)			((v).begin()),((v).end())
#define rall(v)			((v).rbegin()),((v).rend())
#define sz(v)			( (int) (v.size()) )
#define rep(i,n)		for (int i=0;i<n;i++)
#define per(i,n)		for (int i=n-1;i>=0;i--)
#define MOD				1000000007
#define ss	            second
#define ff	            first
int dx[]={0 , 0 , -1 ,1};
int dy[]={-1, 1 ,  0 ,0};

void fast()
{
	std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
	cin.tie(NULL);
	cout.tie(NULL);
}
ll a=0 , b=1; // 0/1=0 initial fraction
ll x , y , n ;
void compare(ll dn , ll i)
{
	ll s1=abs( (b*y)*( (x*i)-(y*dn) ) );
	ll s2=abs( (y*i)*( (b*x)-(a*y ) ) );
	if(s1<s2 ||(s1==s2&&i<b))
		b=i,a=dn;
}
int main()
{
	cin>>x>>y>>n;
	for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
	{
		ll d1, d2;
		d1=i*x/y;
		d2=d1+1;
		compare(d1,i);
		compare(d2,i);
	}
	cout<<a<<"/"<<b;
}
